learning_outcomes.text: Learns the structure and properties of different engineering materials.
Learns the relationship between application area and properties depending on the microstructure of materials.
Learns the basic knowledge required for the use and design of new generation materials under variables such as high temperature and pressure.
Learns the production and design of functional materials (such as nanomaterials, biomaterials, and smart glasses) based on the properties required in practice.

syllabus_topics: Historical development and classification of materials
The journey of glass from the Stone Age to the digital age
Glass as an optical and photonic material
Green Chemistry and Catalytic Functional Materials
Introduction to semiconductor materials and their basic applications
